response.text: {"messages":[{"role":"customer","text":"Hi there! A friend of mine is feeling under the weather and I wanted to get them a pizza. Could you tell me what comes on the Veggie Pizza, and if you have a gluten-free crust option?"},{"role":"business","text":"Hi! The Veggie Pizza comes with tomato sauce, house cheese blend, green peppers, onions, mushrooms, black olives, and tomatoes.
